item.title: New White House press secretary a 'devoted fan' of Trump and MAGA
item.description: Katie Zacharia worked for one of Trump's companies and raised her profile appearing on conservative-leaning talk shows. She also amplified right-wing conspiracy theories. Now she'll be the president's chief spokesperson.

item.title: Government spent $10 million on pro-Trump ads after president said super PAC would fund
item.description: Nearly $22 million in taxpayers funds has been spent to air the ads, with nearly half spent after Trump promised to fund what the White House calls public service announcements through his super PAC.

item.title: Democratic senator talks Trump's Russian diesel deal
item.description: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks to Democratic Senator Jeanne Shaheen of New Hampshire about President Trump's deal for Russian diesel and his claim of an "energy ceasefire" that did not materialize.

item.title: Political strategist on how Trump's personal grievances could affect the GOP
item.description: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with political strategist and former senior Republican congressional adviser Rina Shah about how President Trump's personal grievances and projects are affecting the chances of GOP candidates in the upcoming election.

item.title: Trump struggles to show voters he's focused on the cost of living
item.description: With a deal to import millions of tons of diesel fuel from Russia, President Trump is struggling to show voters that he is focused on the cost of living ahead of the midterms.

item.title: Texas' 15th Congressional District provides clues to state's Latino vote
item.description: The 15th Congressional District runs from the east of San Antonio all the way down into the Rio Grande Valley. This majority-Latino district provides a window into the Latino vote in Texas.

item.title: Politics chat: Trump announces fuel deal with Russia. What does it mean for sanctions?
item.description: President Trump announced a deal to import Russian fuel to the U.S. We look at what this means for the sanctions he recently signed off on against Russia, as well as the U.S.'s support for Ukraine.

item.title: In one of the country's most competitive districts, a Democrat tries to keep her seat
item.description: In a highly competitive Washington congressional race, the incumbent Democrat has angered part of her party base and the Trump-backed Republican challenger faces backlash against the party in power.
